I've been rereading the series and noticed a minor discrepancy in this chapter last night.  Egwene asks Elayne to meet her in Tel'aran'rhiod, but Aviendha appears instead.  The reason she gives is that Elayne "couldn't make the flows work" to use the ter'angreal.  This is obviously a reference to earlier in the book when one of the Wise Ones told Elayne that channeling would become more difficult as her pregnancy progressed, and flows may be harder to work.  However, Elayne and Aviendha have one of the twisted stone ring dream ter'angreal, which don't require any channeling to use, and in fact earlier in the books it's mentioned that they should even work for women who can't channel.
